misprint in Project Gutenberg #1041; 'respose' is not a word. The 1609 Quarto and the Folger Shakespeare both read 'repose'. Found by diffing this text against Folger Digital Texts.
misprint in Project Gutenberg #1041, an extra e. The Folger Shakespeare reads 'debarred'. Found by diffing this text against Folger Digital Texts.

Project Gutenberg 38520 carries a control character (U+001A) where the letter 'a' belongs, here and in 'Pegasus' earlier in the same book. Both are ordinary words rather than Lowell's Yankee spelling, and the character is not permitted in XML, so the text could not be published as TEI until it was repaired.
